title: Workflow Definition
description: This document is the reference shape of a workflow definition. It is stored verbatim (as JSONB) in workflow_versions.definition once a workflow is versioned. It exists for humans and editor tooling to read; the actual enforcement of these rules at run time is done in src/validation/validateWorkflowDefinition.js, because several rules here (no dangling references, no cycles, approvers required) cannot be expressed as plain JSON Schema.

id.description: Unique within the workflow. Referenced by later steps' `inputs` and by condition branches.

inputs.description: Maps an input name this step needs to either a literal value or a reference to a prior step's output.

oneOf.description: Any literal JSON value baked into the definition.

config.description: Type-specific settings. Required keys per type are enforced in code, see src/schema/stepTypes.js.

tools.description: Names of tools/actions this step is allowed to invoke. Empty array means 'calls nothing outside the engine'.

from.description: id of the step whose output is being read.

output.description: name of the field on that step's output.
